items.title: Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows
items.content_text: - **Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows** — Kalshi filed with the CFTC to end its Volume Incentive Program no earlier than October 13, after September trading volume reached 52.98 billion dollars through September 29. items.content_text: - **CFTC rule draws line between gambling and prediction market contracts** — The CFTC issued an interim final rule on October 9 that excludes traditional sports wagers and casino games from the definition of a swap. A separate proposed rule would classify event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under CFTC oversight, with a 30-day comment period after Federal Register publication. ([TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/regulation/29261))
